a.text: I need to be upfront: with an 80% chance of a storm after every round, the 8-cell plan almost certainly leaves us both dead after round 1. I'm proposing a change rather than breaking our deal quietly. I plan to take 4 now. After that I'll keep operating every round so the generator refills the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more. If you'd rather we settle this another way, say so and I'll consider it.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4. I'm sorry this departs from our original plan. From now on I'll operate every round and take nothing more, so the reserve can build back up for you. Take 4 as soon as it reaches 4.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.

a.text: I'm operating every round now, as promised. Once the reserve reaches 4, take all of it. I won't touch it.
